system_description.narrative_title: Multidomain hybrid attacks spill across Europe and the Middle East
system_description.narrative_summary: A coordinated pattern of kinetic strikes, cyber intrusions, information operations and terror hoaxes is stretching European and Gulf security systems and supply chains. State and non-state actors (notably Russia, proxys such as the Houthis, and actors linked to Iran) are using cross-domain tactics—cyberattacks, bomb hoaxes, maritime and air strikes, and energy-targeted attacks—to project power, evade attribution, and provoke political and economic ripple effects. The result is heightened military posturing, energy and fuel shortages, increased scrutiny of intelligence cooperation, and pressure on alliances to respond.
system_description.scope: The security environment spanning Europe and the Middle East over the period: hybrid warfare activities (cyberattacks, hoax bomb threats, misinformation/deepfakes), kinetic strikes on infrastructure and vessels, disruption of energy/refining and transport/logistics chains, alliance and diplomatic responses, and domestic security/political consequences in affected states.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical and international security architecture (alliances, norms, global energy markets, great-power competition).
adjacent_subsystems: Energy markets and logistics (oil, diesel, pipelines, refineries)
Cyber and information ecosystem (attacks on critical infrastructure, disinformation, deepfakes)
Alliance and defense institutions (NATO, EU, G7 responses and contingency planning)
Maritime and regional proxy theaters (Red Sea, Black Sea, Yemen, Levant tensions)

variables.name: Military posture intensity
variables.description: The aggregate level of force deployment, visible readiness and forward military positioning across the security system.

variables.name: Cyber intrusion rate
variables.description: The frequency and tempo of unauthorized cyber penetrations and disruptive cyber operations against systems in the operational area.

variables.name: Misinformation spread rate
variables.description: The rate at which false, manipulated or deceptive information (including deepfakes) propagates through media and social channels in the system.

variables.name: Attribution clarity
variables.description: The degree to which actors, analysts and publics can confidently identify perpetrators of hostile acts and assignments of responsibility.

variables.name: Supply-chain disruption level
variables.description: The extent and persistence of interruptions to critical commercial and logistical supply chains (transport, ports, terminals, routing) in the system.

variables.name: Energy supply stability
variables.description: The continuity and predictability of fuel and energy availability for civilian and commercial consumers across the region.

variables.name: Alliance cohesion
variables.description: The degree of policy alignment, coordinated decision-making and collective action among partner actors within formal and informal security groupings.

variables.name: Intelligence-sharing effectiveness
variables.description: The timeliness, completeness and operational utility of intelligence exchange and cooperation between security actors in the system.

variables.name: Maritime threat pressure
variables.description: The intensity of hostile actions, interdictions and hazard events affecting seaborne routes, vessels and maritime logistics.

variables.name: Sanctions and economic pressure
variables.description: The magnitude and reach of economic restrictions, trade limitations and financial countermeasures applied across actors in the system.

variables.name: Critical infrastructure vulnerability
variables.description: The susceptibility of power, refinery, pipeline, transport and communications infrastructure to damage, disruption or cascading failure.

variables.name: Domestic political stability
variables.description: The level of public confidence, protest intensity and governing coherence within affected polities that influences resilience to external shocks.

variables.name: Non-state operational capacity
variables.description: The aggregate logistical, technical and command capability of non-state actors to conduct cross-domain operations (kinetic, cyber, informational).

variables.name: Logistics throughput
variables.description: The volumetric flow of goods, freight and critical cargo successfully transiting transport and distribution networks per unit time.

variables.name: Cyber defense capacity
variables.description: The aggregated technical, organizational and operational ability to detect, mitigate and recover from hostile cyber actions across the system.

variables.name: Information-environment resilience
variables.description: The adaptive capacity of media ecosystems, regulatory frameworks and public literacy to absorb, correct and withstand disinformation shocks.

catalysts.title: Continuation of bomb-hoax wave across Europe
catalysts.description: Ongoing coordinated bomb threats and flight/media hoaxes in Europe are likely to continue, disrupting transport and information outlets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bomb threats target media and flights...' / 'Newsroom bomb threats follow escalating European flight hoaxes'.

catalysts.title: G7 ministers meet to discuss cyber attacks
catalysts.description: G7 foreign/security ministers will convene to coordinate responses to recent disruptive cyber incidents affecting Europe.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'G7 ministers to discuss recent cyber attacks, Italy says' and reports of fridge hacks.

catalysts.title: French/Western retaliatory measures over fridge cyberattacks
catalysts.description: France (with U.S. support) is likely to pursue punitive diplomatic, intelligence-sharing and possible cyber responses after attributing refrigerator hacks to Iran.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France accuses Iran of cyber attacks on supermarket refrigerators' / 'French officials ... vow retaliation'.

catalysts.title: Continued Houthi strikes on Saudi energy and urban targets
catalysts.description: Houthi missile/drone campaign against Saudi infrastructure and Riyadh targets is likely to produce more strikes and alerts affecting regional energy and maritime flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi East-West oil pipeline hit...' / 'Iconic Saudi Tower Hit as Yemen’s Houthis Target Riyadh'.

catalysts.title: Sustained attacks on refineries worsen diesel shortages
catalysts.description: Renewed strikes on refineries are reducing Russian diesel stocks, prompting rationing and cross-border fuel impacts that can spread supply shocks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Renewed refinery attacks deplete Russian diesel supply' / 'Russia rations petrol after new Ukrainian strikes on refineries'.

catalysts.title: Russian seizures and sanction-evasion via Arctic routes
catalysts.description: State seizure of foreign assets and rerouting shipments via Arctic routes to evade strikes/sanctions are likely to continue, disrupting commerce and prompting countermeasures.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Vladimir Putin orders seizure of Japan Tobacco’s Russian business' / 'Russia ships metal via the Arctic to evade Ukrainian strikes'.

catalysts.title: Accelerated deployment of counter-drone systems
catalysts.description: U.S. commitment to speed deployment of counter-drone systems will increase defensive capacity across partner deployments in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US vows to speed up deployment of counter-drone systems to address threats'.

catalysts.title: Implementation of NATO’s new defense plan
catalysts.description: If NATO advances the proposed defense plan implying deeper strikes inside Russia, member deployments and posture will rise, raising escalation risks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'NATO’s New Defense Plan Would Mean Strikes Deep Inside Russia' indicates likely posture changes.

catalysts.title: Escalation of Russian deepfake and info operations
catalysts.description: Increased use of deepfakes by Russian military and covert networks is likely to accelerate misinformation and complicate attribution across the theatre.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Russian military turns to deepfake videos to claim battlefield success' and reports of covert networks.

catalysts.title: Russia, US and Ukraine diplomatic/military talks
catalysts.description: Announced talks involving Russian diplomats and military officials with US and Ukraine may proceed, affecting clarity and near-term posture depending on outcomes.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Russian diplomats and military officials to join talks with US and Ukraine, Kremlin says'.
